projectDescription: A tiered, subprocess-backed memory extension for the pi coding agent that uses parallel observers to distill conversation history into atomic observations, a branch-local ledger for short-term recall, and a consolidator to promote aging observations into durable per-session topic files.
keyFeatures: Parallel observer subprocesses that distill raw conversation chunks into atomic observations
Branch-local ledger (om.observations.recorded) that stays correct under /tree navigation
Deterministic, model-free compaction rendering the observation buffer into a summary block
Consolidator that promotes aging observations into durable per-session .memory/<sessionId>/ topic files
JOURNEY.md — a running descriptive prose history pushed into every compaction block for orientation
Per-session on/off gate (default OFF) for safe global extension deployment
Cost tracking via pi's built-in usage metrics, surfaced in the footer and /om:status
Fork/clone seeding of long-term memory from parent sessions
publicApiSurface: /om, /om on, /om off — per-session on/off gate command
/om:status — show workers, buffer, clocks, cost, topic files, journey size
Config: chunkTokens, chunkOverlapTokens, poolTargetTokens, consolidateAtPoolTokens, compactAtContextTokens, tailTokens, journeyTargetTokens, observerConcurrency
Env: PI_OM_PASSIVE=1 — forces passive mode (disables all triggers)
Ledger entry types: om.observations.recorded, om.observations.dropped, om.enabled, om.cost, om.folded, om.resume
agent/index.ts — default export: omWorker(pi: ExtensionAPI), env-dispatched on OM_WORKER=observer|consolidator
